info.name: DS1 - Orders & Stock API
info.description: Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner). Ids are stored in collection variables.

exec: pm.test("Has category and suppliers", function () { var p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.category).to.exist; pm.expect(p.suppliers).to.have.length(1); });
pm.test("Has field errors", function () { var d = pm.response.json().details; pm.expect(d.name).to.exist; pm.expect(d.price).to.exist; });
